name: Tanzania
alt: United Republic of Tanganyika and Zanzibar

predecessors.name: British Africa
predecessors.text: Tanganyika, the British-administered Tanganyika Territory, held 'under a League of Nations mandate in 1922'

ledger.x: 1962-12-09: Tanganyika becomes a republic within the Commonwealth.
1964-04-26: Tanganyika and Zanzibar unite as the United Republic of Tanganyika and Zanzibar.
ledger.cpn: People's Republic of Zanzibar and Pemba

ledger.x: 1964-10-29: the United Republic of Tanganyika and Zanzibar is renamed Tanzania.
1979-04: Tanzanian forces hold Uganda after Kampala falls.

wars.name: Zanzibar Revolution
wars.outcome: The revolution 'began on 12 January 1964 and led to the overthrow of the Sultan of Zanzibar'; the country was renamed the People's Republic of Zanzibar and Pemba, and on 26 April it united with Tanganyika.

wars.name: Uganda-Tanzania War
wars.outcome: Tanzanian victory (9 October 1978 - 3 June 1979): Uganda declared the annexation of the Kagera Salient (1 November 1978) and had been ejected from it by early January 1979; Tanzania then invaded and occupied Uganda, taking Kampala on 10-11 April, and Idi Amin…

certainty.note: Inherited colonial frontiers of Tanganyika plus the archipelago of Zanzibar.
